༄༅/ /'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las/smin byed bde chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi lag len gsal bar bkod pa pad+ma rā ga'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhug

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las/ smin byed bde chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi lag len gsal bar bkod pa pad+ma rā ga'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru dzā ha bī ra ya/ 'khor 'das g.yo rtsol rlung lnga'i byed pa kun// g.yo med dhū tir bros shing bcings pa las// gzhom bral dwangs ma'i sku brnyes dpa' bo mchog /pad 'byung grub pa'i 'phrul bsgyur de la 'dud// rlung zas brgyud pa phyi ma yi// bka' srol las byon smin byed gzhung*// mtshams sbyor lang tshos spras nas deng*// skal ldan mchog gi dga' ston sbyin/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i zab chos 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol gyi smin byed bsgrub pa la/ gang gis sbyin pa'i slob dpon ni/ rab lhun grub rnam gsum gyi gding dang ldan pa/ 'bring 'byung lnga'i rlung zas 'byongs pas lto gos kyi 'khri ba chod pa/ tha ma dam tshig ldan cing dbang dang nyams len gyi rgyun bar ma chad pa zhig gis so// gang la sbyin pa'i slob ma ni/ gzhung las/ dbang 'di shin tu gnyan pas tshul dang ldan zhing dka' spyad snying rus la brtson pa ཾ bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba ཾ ci gsung dang du len pa la ster ba'i dus ཾ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal med pa dang tshogs 'khor med pa la ster du mi rung ngo ཾ gsum lnga bdun las spel mi rung ཾ zhes mtshan nyid grangs nges phyag yon bcas gsal bar gsungs pa ltar ro// ji ltar sbyin pa'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la'ang gnyis/ cho gar mi gtogs pa'i sbyor ba ni/ tshes grangs dus sbyor bzang zhing dge ba la gnas khang gtsang mar stegs bu gru bzhi chang dang sin+dhu ra yis byugs pa la/ dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs khor yug dang bcas pa spyi mthun gyi lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ma dmar po'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog ze'u 'brur nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa la lha mtshan yod med gang byas kyang rung bas rdul tshon nam ras bris de ltar bkram/ ma 'byor na me tog tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga pa bkod pa'i steng khri'u'i khar bum pa mgul chings dmar po so lnga'i bcud ldan kha rgyan rma bya shel dang me long phag mo'i tsaka lis brgyan pa bkod/

g.yas su ban+dha'am rin po che'i snod du dpal gtor rin chen 'bar ba g.yung drung dga' ba 'khyil bas spras pa/ g.yon du thod pa mtshan ldan nang byang sems dkar dmar gyi phabs rgyun chang dang mngar gsum sbyar bas bkang ba'i khar me long sin+dhu ra brdal ba la chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs grwar dga' 'khyil dang lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi dbus dang lngar hrīḥm ha ri ni sa bris pas bkab la dar dmar gyi gur phub/ mdun du mar zan gyi ting lo sbar chog slob ma re la gsum re tsho bcad pa/ rgyab tu dpal 'bar mda' gang ba dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga sa stegs lta bur phyogs bzhi dbus lngar btsugs pa/ mtshams su chas dbang ras dkar gzan/ sgom thag /dar dmar ang rag /dur khrod chas brgyad rnams dngos sam tsaka lir bris pa bkod/ rgyab mdun gang bder sman raka gtor gsum/ phyi mchod bskor bsham bya/ las bum/ sngon gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ srung ma gza' bdud kyi gtor 'bul/ chad brtan sogs nyer mkho rnams kyang bsdogs/ slob ma du yod kyi grangs mnyam ras gzan sgom thag ang rag rnams bsang sbyang*/ khrus dang bgegs bskrad byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang raṃ yig re bri/ 1$0000250thams cad ye shes kyi me phung rab tu 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can du 1$0000300 bsam la byin brlab bo// gnyis pa cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba ni/ bdag mdun dbyer med phag mo'i phrin las kho na gtang yang rung mod kyi/ cung zad spro na tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ bgegs gtor brlab bsngo spyi mthun/ phrin las dag pa rab 'byams kyi bka' bsgo nas maṇ+ḍal bar song nas/ gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'beb btang la dbang len bya/ mchod brlab byin 'beb nas brtsam/ srid mtsho mi zad 'khor ba dong sprugs shog bar bdag bskyed phrin las gsal 'debs byas la/ bla sgrub 'od phung rang grol ltar lus dkyil gyi dmigs pa dang sbyar la/ hrīḥgu ru pad+ma ā yur+dz+nyā na

sogs rlung bzlas ngag bzlas ci nus bya/ hūm̐ hrī sku lnga yongs rdzogs sogs kyis bstod/ de nas lha btsun rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi phag mo'i las byang gis dbang sgrub gtang ba gong ma rnams kyi phyag len du snang bas/ rang gzhung phrin las mi btang na bgegs bskrad nas mthar chags su gtang dgos kyang bdag bskyed gong smos sbyor ba'i tshe mchod brlab dang bskyed chog nas brtsam bzlas pa'i bar las byang rdzogs par gtang zhing mdun bskyed dbang rdzas la dmigs pa'i spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ci nus bya/ bum bzlas logs su spro na spyi 'gre ltar bya zhing mthar stong tshigs phul/ chos srung spyi dang khyad par bka' srung gsol kha dgra bgegs myur sgrol tshang ba gtang*/ tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma'i bar song ba dang*/ las bum nang du pad zla'i gdan/ lnga tshom dbus dang phyogs bzhi ru// 'byung lnga'i lha mo mthing dkar ser// dmar ljang rang mdog bum pa 'dzin// zhi 'dzum dar dang rin chen brgyan// bzlas pas rgyud bskul bum nang nas// 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma dag byed rgyun// babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur// ces gsal gdab la/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe sogs khrus bdun rig pa ci 'grub bzla/ mthar lha mo rnams mi dmigs par bzhag /go yul sogs 'grigs shing spro na 'di dag gi tshe slob ma rnams dzap bzla zhing dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa la bskor ba byed du gzhug /dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgrib bo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ slob ma du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i gdan g.yung drung raṃ gyis mtshan pa re re bting*/ slob ma pho mo bdun las mi mang ba phyi sgor khrus bya/ yol ba'i phyi rol du brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang maṇ+ḍal phyag mchod ci 'grub bya bar gsungs pa 'di kho na'i smin slob la gzhung don rnams ma chad par bya dgos kyang dkyus 'gre tsam la de dag ma 'grub kyang chad skyon du mi 'gyur/

gang ltar bgegs gtor byin rlabs bsngo ba sogs spyi mthun byas nas las byang ltar bka' bsgo drag tu byas nas srung 'khor bsgom/ nang du 'ong nas pho rnams g.yas dang mo rnams g.yon gral du 'khod du gzhug /sems bskyed gsal gdab/ drang nges chos bshad kyi rigs dang brgyud pa'i rnam thar lo rgyus gzhung gi dbu ltar 'chad pa'am/ mdor bsdu na/ de la zab mo'i gdams ngag 'di nyid gang las byung ba'i brgyud tshul mdor bsdus pa tsam 'chad na/ de'ang 'og min chos kyi dbyings chos sku'i zhing khams dmigs pas ma grub pa na 'khor 'das thams cad kyi spyi dpal gdod ma ye bzhugs kyi mgon po chos sku 'od mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba de nyid kyis ka dag zang thal bzang ngan gyi dbye bsal dang bral ba thig le lnga ldan 'od lnga gcal du bkram pa lhun grub bde chen gyi zhing khams na longs spyod rdzogs sku thugs rje chen po mtshan dpe nges pa lnga dang ldan pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa de nyid la gsungs des shar phyogs ri bo ta la zhes bya bar rigs gsum mgon po'i pho brang 'od zer gyi gur khang du sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa sku la skye 'chi dang bgres rgud mi mnga' ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma kun gyis g.yog byed pa dregs pa sde brgyad bran du khol ba de nyid la gsungs des rgya gar grub thob chen po ma hā nā tha zhes par sprul de nyid kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr zhes pa 'pho med 'od lus grub pa de nyid la gnang de la slob ma grub pa thob pa'i skyes chen 'ja' lus zag med du grub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang yongs grags kyi bu chen 'pho med 'od lus grub pa brgyad byon pa'i gtso bo badz+ra nā thas bla ma'i lung bstan dang gdul bya dus la babs nas bod du pheb dbur stod 'bri khung du lha sras mu khri btsan po'i rnam 'phrul gter ston gnam lcags me 'bar ram

sna tshogs rang grol rin chen phun tshogs zhes pa de nyid la yongs rdzogs gnang zhing bka' babs so de'ang rang gter gsang lung las/ e ma nga yi gdams ngag nyon mongs rang grol la gces par dgos pa'i rlung zas lag len ni lha sras skye ba brgyud de chos 'di dang 'phrad tshe nga dang mi gnyis dzā ha bīr rgya gar yul 'byung grub pa'i rig 'dzin brnyes de yi yang zab rlung gi gdams pa ni 'chi med grub pa'i gnad kun lon gyur te pad+ma nga yi thugs rjes 'phrad pas longs zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe gcig lus gcig la 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i gdams ngag dzā ha bīr rlung khrid phyi nang gsang gsum yongs rdzogs kyi bka' babs/ de nas rim par rdzogs chen pa tshul khrims sangs rgyas/ mnga' ris pa 'od gsal mchog ldan/ bres gshong bla chen chos rgyal rdo rje/ grub chen nyi zla klong gsal gyi bar du grub thob kho na'i brgyud pa tshar du dngar ba byon cing*/ khyad par grub chen nyi zla klong gsal lam 'ja' lus snang stong rang grol nyid la grub chen dzā ha bīr gyis zhal dngos su bstan/ zhag bcu gsum gyi bar du smin byed kyi dbang bskur/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa bstsal nas nyid dang mi gnyis pa'i go 'phang mthon por bkod pa de nyid kyi bka' srol las byon pa'i smin byed bde chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bsgrub pa la/ bdag nyid kyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub pa lags/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul 'tshal/ ces brjod la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / thog mar theg pa thun mong gi 'jug sgo dang mthun cing sdom pa'i rten du gyur pa skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi zhing*/

srid pa'i 'khrul rtog chos nyid 'od gsal chen por sbyang ba'i slad du byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ hrī sdug bsngal las kyis mnar ba'i skye 'gro rnams zung 'jug 'ja' lus 'od sku ma thob bar bde gshegs rigs 'dus lha la skyabs su mchi gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'phrang las bsgral ba'i phyir 'khrul pa rang dag ngang du sems bskyed do lan gsum/ tshogs kyi zhing sngar gsal btab pa'i spyan sngar gsag sbyang kun gyi snying po yan lag bdun pa tshig dang mthun pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal thobs la 'di'i rjes zlos/ hūm̐ hrī ka dag ngang las lhun grub skur bzhengs pa'i rang rtsal rig pa rang shar lha tshogs rnams 'ja' 'od 'od phung thig le'i klong nas gshegs snang srid dag pa rab 'byams mchod par 'bul sgo gsum sdig sgrib nyams chag dag gyur cig zag med dge la yi rangs chos 'khor bskul 'chi med rtag par bzhugs gsol dge ba'i mthus 'gro kun 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog gsum/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gis rgyud sbyang ba'i slad du lus gnad bsrang*/ sna bug g.yas nas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang las gyur pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib grib dang mi gtsang ba rtsa dug rlung dug thig le'i nyes skyon thams cad kha dog dmar po'i rnam pas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar sang sang song bar bsam la rlung drag po lan gsum 'bud par zhu/ zhes byas la 1$0000250sna bug g.yon nas tshur g.yon pa'i mdzub mos bkab/ g.yas nas drag rlung lan gsum 'bud 1$0000300 du gzhug /des 'gres te/ sna bug g.yon nas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags las gyur pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib grib dang mi gtsang ba rtsa dug rlung dug thig le'i nyes skyon thams cad/ kha dog ser po'i rnam pas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar sang sang song bar bsam la rlung 'jam po lan gsum 'bud par zhu/1$0000250 gong las go ldog ste g.yon nas 'jam rlung lan gsum 'bud 1$0000300

du gzhug / sna bug gnyis kyi dbus nas nyon mongs pa gti mug las gyur pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib grib dang mi gtsang ba rtsa dug rlung dug thig le'i nyes skyon thams cad/ 'od kha dog nag po'i rnam pas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar sang sang song bar bsam la rlung 'jam rtsub ran pos lan gsum 'bud par zhu/ zhes byas la sna bug gnyis ka nas ma ning rlung lan gsum 'bud du gzhug / de ltar phyi nang gi sdig sgrib bsal bas khyed rang gi lus me shel gyi gong bu ltar dri ma med la 'od 'bar bar gyur par mos la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dad mos gdung shugs drag pos thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs bdag cag nyon mongs 'khor ba las bsgral phyir ye shes dkyil 'khor du bde stong zag pa med pa yi dbang mchog dam pa bstsal du gsol smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol ye shes bde drod sbar du gsol lan gsum/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu dkyil 'khor dam pa'i sgor zhugs nas smin cing grol bar 'dod pa na bla ma'i bsgo ba nyan pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung nus na ji ltar 'dod pa sbyin par bya zhes dris pa'i lan gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ho bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis ji ltar bsgo ba'i gsung nyan cing dam tshig dag las mi 'da' bsrung thugs rje brtse bas gzung du gsol rdo rje lag tu gtad/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag / hūm̐ hrī nga ni dbang chen he ru ka khyed la dam tshig sbyin par bya rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams nyams pa med par rtag tu bsrung gal te nyams na dmyal bar ltung ma nyams byin rlabs dngos grub sogs khyod kyi ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad ma lus myur du 'grub sa ma ya u da ka ṭha ṭha na ra kan spyir theg pa che chung gi sdom pa'i bslab bya/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag gis bsdus pa mtha' dag bag yod dran shes dang ldan pas tshul bzhin du bsrung bar bya dgos so// de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god pa'i phyir ye shes pa dbab pa la khyed rang rnams lus gnad rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung bca'/

lag pa gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyor/ ngag gnad smra ba skyungs la rlung bzung*/ yid kyi gnad gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs snod kyi 'jig rten dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams chos 'byung dmar nag yangs pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla bam ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ khyed rang rnams dus gsum rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar gsal sin+dhu ra'i mdangs ldan khro zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can dbu gtsug phag zhal ngur ba/ phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams shing kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon du brten pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon do shal rus pa'i phyag rgyas brgyan pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum me phung dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong du 'gying ba'i lus kyi nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal ba'i spyi bor haṃ yig dkar po gyen du bzhengs pa/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdor a shad dmar gsal me'i mdangs can/ snying gar dga' ba 'khyil ba dmar po g.yon du 'khor bar bsam bshang sgor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos a thung las me 'bar zhing spyi bor haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs dga' ba 'khyil ba la phog pas rgyud bskul te rang dbang med par drag tu 'khor ba las 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa ltar byon nas byin gyis rlob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /

ye shes dbab pa'i rdzas bsreg /rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūm̐ hrī chos dbyings bde chen dpal ri 'od gsal klong dag pa rab 'byams mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' sprin 'khrigs rang byung lhun grub pad 'byung yab yum dang zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa gsum dwangs ma'i lha 'dir byon skal ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs hūm̐ hrī o rgyan dur khrod pho brang chen po nas chos dbyings ngang las khro mo'i skur sprul ma rdo rje phag mo dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig 'dir byon skal ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs shar phyogs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gnas mchog nas dkar mo zhi mdzad zhi ba'i skur sprul ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig 'dir byon skal ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs lho phyogs dpal ldan rin chen gnas mchog nas ser mo rgyas mdzad rgyas pa'i skur sprul ma rin chen mkha' 'gro dbyings nas skur= 'dir byon skal ldan= nub phyogs dbang sdud pad+ma'i gnas mchog nas dmar mo dbang mdzad dbang gi skur sprul ma pad+ma mkha' 'gro dbyings nas skur= 'dir byon skal ldan= byang phyogs tshar gcod las kyi gnas mchog nas ljang mo las mdzad phrin las skur sprul ma las kyi mkha' 'gro dbyings nas skur= 'dir byon skal ldan= dam tshig mkha' 'gro sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dang sha za mkha' 'gro 'jig rten mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro sde brgyad srung ma las byed rnams thugs rjes myur mgyogs glog ltar 'khyug cing byon thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'ja' 'od thibs se thib ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer ta la la bde stong zag med 'ja' 'od khyil li li 'pho med 'ja' lus 'od phung phungs se phung dga' bzhi 'dzag bral bde stong phri li li rang lus snang stong lha skur spungs se spung bde drod ye shes me dpung lhabs se lhab dwangs ma ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol ye shes rnam lnga'i me dpung sbar du gsol rang byung gtum mo'i bde drod sbar du gsol

'ja' lus 'od gsal klong du grol ba dang zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog oṃ sarba ma hā gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na dz+wa la raṃ raṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhes drag tu brjod cing me tog 'thor/ phebs rtags spyi dang mthun/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ nam mkha' gang ba'i ye shes pa rnams khyed rang gi sgo gsum la thim pas ye shes pa'i sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa de nyid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram du bzhag / de dag gis 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul 'tshal/ dbang don gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ hūm̐ hrī bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la bdag sogs gus pas gsol ba 'debs dbang bskur byin rlabs bstsal du gsol smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol lan gsum/ bum pa rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang du nang bcud bla ma sku gsum gyi lha tshogs rang rig rang shar gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rgyun khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor babs lus kyi nang gang*/ gtor blugs kyi bya ba mthar phyin/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa gnas lngar bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī chos sku longs sku sprul pa'i sku bla ma sku gsum bde ba che rigs kyi bu la byin gyis rlobs byin rlabs bde stong dbang bskur stsol oṃ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ tsan+dha lī shwa ra sarba ta thā ga te shwa ra raṃ swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ bum chu 'thor 'thung byar gzhug / rjes 'brel du mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs kyi pho brang bde stong ban+dha/ gsal stong mar me/ rig stong me long gi brda gnas gsum bzhag pas de dag gi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes/

gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thod pa mar me me long gnas gsum du bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī byin rlabs mkha' 'gro bde ster ma ye shes dbyings kyi rang bzhin mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur bas bde drod phrin las dbang thob shog oṃ sarba ma hā gu ru badz+ra de ba ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na dz+wa la raṃ raṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gsang rdzas ban+dha kha phyes te/ bla ma dbang chen rta mchog yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dkar dmar byang chub sems kyi rgyun thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas phung khams skye mched rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par mos shig / bdud rtsi khar sbyin cing gnas lngar thig le bkod la/ hūm̐ hrī lus la rtsa rlung thig le byang sems gnas de dag ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs gnas te ngo bo sangs rgyas rnams kyi rang bzhin can gzhan du bsgom bya sgom byed ci la yod dbus ma snying po'i rtsa ru byang sems gnas pa'i phyir rtsa rlung thig le drod kyi dbang bskur ro gong gsal bum dbang gi sngags brjod/ ho skal ldan khyod la rtsa rlung thig le drod kyi dbang bskur pas bde drod rtogs pa rgyud la skyes nas bcom ldan rta phag yab yum gyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par gyur cig de ltar byin pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis rtsa 'khor lo lnga sogs grangs can grangs med kyi rtsa rlung thig le thams cad la khyab lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes shing brtan par mos shig /mtshon byed rtags kyi rdor dril snying gar bzhag cing lag tu gtad pas thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba'i brda khong du chud de mtshon bya don dam bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig / rdor dril snying gar gtugs lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐ hrī bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang

rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas byin rlabs bde drod rang 'bar zhing blo 'das mtha' bral rtogs par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥtrāṃ hrīḥ.ā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ de'i rjes 'brel mar me spyi bo dang lag mthil gnyis su bzhag pas rang rig sku gsum rang gsal gyi me lces nyon mongs dug gsum gyi tshang tshing bsregs/ ye shes gsum ldan gnas lugs kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ chags med bde drod kyi nus pa rtsal rdzogs su smin par mos shig / ting lo gsum sbar la spyi bo dang lag mthil gnyis su bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī nyon mongs tshang tshing bud shing sreg ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me mchog skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas chags bral bde drod 'bar bar shog ā+oṃ karma mā le ma hā su kha ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa ho dpal 'bar kha dog lnga ldan lhun grub ye shes rnam lnga'i rang mdangs lhun rdzogs kyi gzhal med khang du rtsa gsum rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu 'od phung 'ja' zer gyi rnam par bzhugs pa las 'phros pa'i me 'od kyis gnyis 'dzin sgrib pa'i bag chags bsregs shing bcom/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur par mos la rang bzhin 'od gsal chen po'i ngo bor mnyam par zhog cig / dpal 'bar sbar ba gdengs shing gnas lngar bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī dpal 'bar me dpung 'ja' 'od gzhal yas su bla ma rtsa gsum 'od phung 'ja' zer 'khrigs ma sring mkha' 'gro grangs med rnam mang 'tshogs ye shes 'od lnga'i me dpung lhabs se lhab bag chags gnyis 'dzin bud shing bsregs gyur nas gzhon nu bum skur 'pho med 'jigs bral shog / sngags bum dbang ltar brjod/ gzhi nyon mongs dug lngas srid pa'i 'khor lor 'khrul pa la/ lam ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa rgyud la bskyed pas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas sku lnga'i go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur ba'i don nges par gyis shig /lus sems bde drod 'bar ba'i chas gos dang dur khrod rol pa'i chas rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas gsang chen zab mo'i lam gyi rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob cing*/

brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rtsal chen phyogs med du rdzogs par mos shig / ras gos sgom thag ang rag dur khrod chas rnams gnas so sor bgo ba'i tshul byas la/ hūm̐ hrī gzung 'dzin gos spangs ras dkar dri med dang bde stong zung 'jug thabs shes sgom thag dang mkha' 'gro dbang sdud dar dmar ang rag dang mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i dur khrod chas dbang gis skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas snang ba dbang sdud mkha' spyod myur bgrod shog sngags gong ltar brjod/ yongs rdzogs gtor chen gyi dbang bskur ba la 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ gtor snod ye shes zang thal gyi gzhal yas khang du gtor ma rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sprin gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pas sku gsung thugs las byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas sgrib pa bzhi dag /dbang bzhi thob/ phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du 'grub par byas par mos shig / dpal gtor gnas gsum du bzhag la/ hūm̐ hrī zhi rgyas dbang drag thogs med rgyal phrin las yongs rdzogs bkra shis 'bar skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas 'bar 'dzag bde drod mthar phyin zhing bar chad bdud las rgyal bar shog sngags gong ltar brjod/ me tog 'thor la shis brjod rgyas par bya/ de lta bu'i dbang zab mo yang gsang rmad du byung ba thob nas dam tshig bsrung ba gal che bsrung bya'i dam tshig rgyas par sa ma ya 'bum sder gsungs kyang mdor bsdu na nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems dang gsang sngags dam tshig ma nyams bsrung khyad par dam tshig sku gsung thugs srog la bab kyang bsrung bar bya zhes gsungs pa ltar spyi dang khyad par gyis bsdus pa'i bsrung bya rnams la spang blang tshul bzhin du bya ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus dbul/ dge bsngo spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams gyes/

slob dpon gyis bskul dang gtor skyong nas shis brjod kyi bar phag mo'i las gzhung nyid mthar dbyung*/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang byas la sngon 'gro byin rlabs thugs rje'i 'od 'bar gsham gyi smon lam dang bkra shis brjod pas legs par grub bo// srid la nges 'byung dka' spyad mtha' ru phyin// rlung sems las rung zab mo'i lam 'di las// tshe gcig 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes te// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs byed shog /ces sngon bsags las 'phro bzang pos zab chos khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid thos pa'i snod rung du gyur pa pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs yang khrod shrī de bī ko ṭir zin bris su btab pa dge legs 'phel/// /
